messages:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — prepping a Day 0 integration playbook for ISV tooling (LangChain / LlamaIndex adapters, gateway connectors, orchestrator hooks). Goal: clear handoff for partners + HW/SI checklist for marketplace listing & joint announce. TL;DR: want a short runbook + 2-week pilot window.

Mira: love it. can you add required telemetry/events we need for Redwood Optimize? e.g., latency, token counts, model_fallback_code, cache_hit/miss.

Ben: adding. also include quantization profile compatibility (int8/int4) + preferred container image layout (distroless) and manifest schema version.

Olivia: for marketplace listings we need these assets: 1-pager, deploy script, manifest.yml, smoke test harness, screenshots/gifs. i'll draft templates and a minimal markdown checklist.

Sam: SI ask — we need a validated node-type perf matrix for our hardware partners; can eng provide numbers for T4, A100, H100 and a recommended bundle sizing for an initial Dedicated pool?

Jordan: yes — will pull perf matrix. Ben, can you add quickbench outputs and the automation to reproduce? also let's include an acceptance test flow: smoke -> load -> regression.

Ben: pushing a quickbench script to the integration repo, snippet:```bash
./bench.sh --model meta-llama --seq 2048 --batch 8 --profile brief
``` will commit full outputs to /benchmarks/isv-runbook/ later today.

deploy-bot: pipeline triggered: isv/integration-runbook CI (build/tests) — https://ci.redwood.internal/1234 :rocket:

Mira: propose we include a canary/rollback recipe for Dedicated vs Hosted fallback. quick policy suggestion: 10% canary for 1h, auto rollback on >5% error-rate OR p50 latency >200ms sustained for 5m. add an opt-in metric for partner to surface degraded quality (semantic drift) flagged by evals.

Olivia: marketing needs co-announcement copy by EOD Monday. Sam, can partners confirm logo assets + approved quote? we'll prepare a short tech blurb and joint demo script.

Sam: pinged BlueForge + SI-Edge for assets; expecting logos + legal OK by Tue. also requested a 20min joint demo slot at the next partner summit.

Jordan: next steps: Olivia -> marketplace asset checklist + draft copy, Ben -> commit bench scripts & manifest examples, Mira -> telemetry & canary recipe, Sam -> collect partner assets and confirm demo slot. i'll consolidate into a one-pager and share with Eng PMs. meeting Weds 10am PT? :calendar:

Mira: works for me.

Ben: yep.

Olivia: yep.

Sam: attending.

Jordan: thanks all — i'll post the runbook draft here once i've merged the pieces.
